# Standard Step 10 release acceptance

Use release-player-standard v1. Record PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE/N/A with evidence; justify N/A. Never infer human acceptance.

| Gate | Result | Evidence / remaining limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| One release/ directory, in-place rebuild, current assets only | Pending | |
| Root, player/ and subdirectory entry, no missing assets | Pending | |
| Stable Preparing/ready title, credits, release info and correct links | Pending | |
| Live original first-animation background, dark legible overlay | Pending | |
| Start, stop/restart and original startup state | Pending | |
| Pointer click/hold/drag/cancel and touch/keyboard timeline | Pending | |
| Paused/running, rapid/backward cue, matching graphics/audio epoch | Pending | |
| Seek latency p50/p95/max, graphics+audio checkpoint state/PCM checks | Pending | |
| Space, arrows, F, Escape, native input keys | Pending | |
| Volume, scale, fullscreen and narrow layout | Pending | |
| FPS from presented frames, worker/seek metrics | Pending | |
| Original-cursor module grid or truthful non-module/silence diagnostics | Pending | |
| Diagnostics reads leave PCM/state unchanged | Pending | |
| Independent actual canvas scene/transition/ending expectations | Pending | |
| Original-code audio and full integrated run/synchronization | Pending | |
| Per-phase page/worker/render/seek/transition performance | Pending | |
| No fixtures, validation routes, oracle/capture leaks or unused builds | Pending | |
| Hash manifest, exact preview/deploy commands and remaining differences | Pending | |
| Human review of final packaged full audiovisual run | Pending | |

Publication is human-owned. Framework synthetic tests prove infrastructure only. Missing gates keep Step 10 incomplete/action needed.
